_why: The filled glyphs the web SHELL draws by name (core-shell, the tab bar, Button, Feedback, the home/catalogue/doctors cards). They stay in the by-name record of the web mirror (icons/fill.ts); every other glyph is drawn through FIcon's `glyph` prop from icons/fill-glyphs.ts, so a page ships only the outlines it draws. The mirror also keeps every glyph named in SERVICE_ICONS and in packages/ui/components/*.tsx. A name missing here is not a bug: it is a type error at the call site that does not pass `glyph`.
